name: Pet Health Monitoring
description: Guides at-home health monitoring for dogs and cats covering normal versus abnormal indicators, weekly health check routines, and when to call the veterinarian. Produces a monitoring checklist and abnormality reference guide. Use when the user asks about at-home pet health checks, normal vital signs for dogs or cats, when to take a pet to the vet, or how to monitor a pet's health between veterinary visits. Do NOT use for diagnosing specific diseases, recommending medications or treatments, or replacing veterinary examination. This skill helps owners observe and report -- not diagnose or treat.
